The Mission:

# Rapidly build interactive    3D apps for the web.

`>npm i @threlte/core` [Start Building →](https://threlte.xyz/docs/learn/getting-started/introduction)

A 3D framework for the web.

Built on top of
Svelte
and
Three.js.


Declarative Components


## Scale with ease.


Threlte lets you use every feature of Three.js in a declarative way. Compose your scene with
Threlte's render components and let Threlte handle the rest.

Leverage the lifecycle of Svelte components to subscribe to
events, handle state changes and more.

[Make Your First Scene](https://threlte.xyz/docs/learn/getting-started/your-first-scene)

Copy

```
<T.Mesh
  scale={2}
  position.x={10}
  onclick={() => {
    console.log('click!')
  }}
>
  <T.BoxGeometry args={[1, 1, 2]} />
  <T.MeshStandardMaterial color="hotpink" />
</T.Mesh>
```

Community driven


## Batteries included.


Threlte comes with integrations for [Rapier](https://rapier.rs/), a best-in-class physics engine, [Theatre.js](https://www.theatrejs.com/), an animation library with a professional motion design toolset and `@threlte/gltf`, a tool to transform GLTF files into Threlte components.

On top of that `@threlte/extras` provides a collection of useful components and utilities
to get you started.

[Documentation](https://threlte.xyz/docs/reference/extras/getting-started)

@threlte/rapier


Copy

```
<script>
  import { RigidBody, AutoColliders } from '@threlte/rapier'
  import { T } from '@threlte/core'
</script>

<RigidBody>
  <AutoColliders shape="ball">
    <T.Mesh receiveShadow castShadow>
      <T.SphereGeometry args={[0.25]} />
      <T.MeshStandardMaterial />
    </T.Mesh>
  </AutoColliders>
</RigidBody>
```

@threlte/extras


Copy

```
<script>
  import { GLTF, Float } from '@threlte/extras'
</script>

<Float>
  <GLTF
    castShadow
    receiveShadow
    url="/models/flower.glb"
    position.y={1}
    scale={3}
  />
</Float>
```

Plugins


## Fill the gap.


A single component is at the core of Threlte: `<T>`. But sometimes you need
more. Add custom props and custom events to `<T>` with type-safe _Plugins_
that can hook into every aspect of Threlte's render component.

[Documentation](https://threlte.xyz/docs/learn/advanced/plugins)

look-at-plugin.ts


Copy

```
import { injectPlugin } from '@threlte/core'

injectPlugin('lookAt-plugin', (args) => {
	$effect(() => {
		if (!args.ref.lookAt) return
		args.ref.lookAt(args.props.lookAt)
	})

  return {
    pluginProps: ['lookAt']
  }
})
```
